name: Shroodle
description: Shroodle, the Toxic Mouse Pokémon. Able to evolve into Grafaiai. A Poison and Normal type.
pokedex_entries: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.
To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.
